# Error #55: BeneficiaryBudgetExceeded

<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-error-catalog.mjs. Do not edit manually. -->

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#55`
- **Variant Name**: `BeneficiaryBudgetExceeded`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::SponsorBudgetBeneficiaryExceeded` — the claim would exceed the per-beneficiary budget cap.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/sponsor_test.rs::beneficiary_cap_rejects_within_the_sponsor_window`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/sponsor_test.rs::beneficiary_cap_rejects_within_the_sponsor_window). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// SponsorBudgetBeneficiaryExceeded — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let sponsor = Address::generate(&f.env);
register_sponsor(&f, &sponsor, 1_000_000, 1);
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.advance_time(2 * DAY);
enroll(&f, &f.recipient);
Some(rejected!(sponsored_claim(&f, &sponsor, id, 100, 1, {
    f.env.ledger().timestamp() + DAY
})))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked beneficiary_cap_rejects_within_the_sponsor_window
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Wait for the sponsor window to roll or reduce the claim; the per-beneficiary cap is enforced separately from the sponsor's overall period cap.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer)
